name: polyroom-verify
description: Draw a polygon room with the Polygon tool: pick tool, click vertices, Enter to close.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: verify
steps.eval: (function(){var rooms=window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms;if(rooms.length<=window.__roomsBefore)throw new Error('no room added: '+rooms.length+' vs '+window.__roomsBefore);var last=rooms[rooms.length-1];if(!last.polygon||last.polygon.length<3)throw new Error('room has no polygon: '+JSON.stringify(last.polygon));return 'polygon-room-ok:'+last.polygon.length+'verts'})()
